[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Teral''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as head of [[House Teral]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]], during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. With the aid of a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]], he joined into an alliance with [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] that was solidified by the [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] of his daughter [[Fasha Teral-Organa|Fasha]] to [[Lew Organa]].
